datasets.name: Airborne LiDAR point cloud
datasets.source: Sichuan Bureau of Surveying and Mapping (SBSM)
datasets.verbatim: The airborne LiDAR data was initially used to obtain the point cloud (provided by Sichuan Bureau of Surveying and Mapping (SBSM), and the point cloud density is 30 pints/m2) from Wuhuahai to Rizegou

datasets.name: UAV optical images
datasets.source: Sichuan Bureau of Surveying and Mapping (SBSM)
datasets.verbatim: At the same time, we also obtained the same range of UAV optical images (0.2 m × 0.2 m) from SBSM

datasets.name: Historical landslide inventory
datasets.verbatim: Visually inspecting the RRIM layer, we interpreted a total of 1949 historical landslides within the study site

methods.name: Lightweight Attention U-Net (LAU-Net)
methods.summary: A deep learning architecture for semantic segmentation of landslides, combining a U-Net encoder-decoder structure with Attention Gates to emphasize landslide features and Tversky loss for optimization, designed to handle sparse landslide data in vegetated areas.
methods.source: Chengyong Fang, Xuanmei Fan, Hao Zhong, Luigi Lombardo, Hakan Tanyas, and Xin Wang
methods.verbatim: We design a Lightweight Attention U-Net (LAU-Net) for historical landslides identification based on a combined U-Net and Attention Gate architecture.

availability.author_statement: The raw/processed data required to reproduce these findings cannot be shared at this time as the data also forms part of an ongoing study.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and input datasets are not linked or publicly available, and the custom LAU-Net code lacks a repository or persistent link.
